On Thu, 2008-02-28 at 03:19 +0100, Florian Strunk wrote: > I have use >  > git clone git://kernel.ubuntu.com/nigelc/ubuntu-gutsy+tuxonice.git >  > and it has worked. >  > After compiling and installing, the debug_info of tuxonice shows the > verion 3.0-rc6 >  > I go to bed now and try the version the next day :-) >  > There were two new option at the kernel config pre_hibernate?? and > something other. > I have copied the lines to an editor, but forgot to save. > I have type y for both options. What do this two options? You probably don't want 'y' there. The two values are the names of programs that TuxOnIce will attempt to start before hibernating and after completing a resume. The idea is that the hibernate script could be invoked in this way, allowing us to have better support for making TuxOnIce a drop-in replacement for swsusp. Regards, Nigel ------------------------------ _______________________________________________ TuxOnIce-users mailing list enpsfhxz-stvnz@lists.tuxonice.net http://lists.tuxonice.net/mailman/listinfo/tuxonice-users End of TuxOnIce-users Digest, Vol 36, Issue 35 **********************************************
